QuestInfo.name: [Eluna] Starbound
QuestInfo.1: #p9400464# empathizes with the plight of the ancient Ryuul, and wonders where they went after leaving Eluna.\r\nSearch Eluna for clues about where #p9400464#'s ancestors went. Take pictures and bring them back to her.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered the ruins of an astronomical facility once used to observe the heavens.\r\n#p9400464# said this facility was used to plot a course to a distant star...\r\nDid #p9400464#'s ancestors really set off for that star?

default.0: Have you found anything yet? If we can determine where my ancestors headed, we'll know where to look next.
